summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K on 26 May 2026 reporting a routine director/PDMR shareholding notification under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. The filing discloses that Catherine Woods (a non-executive director) and James Woods (a closely associated person) acquired 3,084 ordinary shares of 10p each at GBp 97.8866 per share via reinvestment of the 2025 final dividend paid on 19 May 2026. There is no special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. This is a standard disclosure of an insider's dividend reinvestment transaction.
